question: In February 2022, West Bengal government launched an open-air classroom programme for students from Class 1 to 7, by the name ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paray Shikshalaya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Paray Shikshalaya** is an **open-air classroom programme **launched by the **West Bengal **government in **February 2022.**
 
• The programme is aimed at providing education to students from **Class 1 to 7** in an **outdoor environment.**
 
• The initiative is a part of the state government's efforts to promote outdoor learning and **reduce the impact of the COVID-19 **pandemic on education.
 
• Under the Paray Shikshalaya programme, schools will be set up in **open spaces** such as **parks, playgrounds, and community halls,** where students can attend classes in a **safe and socially distanced manner.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shiksha Abhiyan** is a nationwide programme launched by the Government of India in** 2001.**

 
 
• It aimed at promoting **universal elementary education.**
 
 
 
• **Samagra Shiksha** is another initiative launched by the Government of India in **2018.**
 
 
• It aimed at improving the **quality of education** in schools.
 
 
 
• **SHREYAS** is a scheme launched by the **Ministry of Education in 2019.**
 
 
• It aimed at providing industry **apprenticeship opportunities** to students.
